units: <cite ref="Mishnah Tevul Yom 2:3">T’bul Yom II, 3</cite> <he>מפני שהוא רוצה בפִיזּוּרוֹ</he> because the scattering (of the garlic in the mortar) is welcome to him.

<cite ref="Shabbat 16b:8">Sabb. 16ᵇ</cite> <he>בשעת פ׳ עבים</he> when the clouds were dispersing. Sifra M’tsorʿa, Par. 2, ch. II (<cite ref="M02395"><he>מקום</he></cite>) <he>פ׳ שיער</he> isolated hairs.
<cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 8:5">Snh. VIII, 5</cite> <he>פ׳ לרשעים וכ׳</he> dispersion (separation) of the wicked is a profit to them and to the world; a. e.
